advertisement.title: Digital products built close to real needs.
advertisement.body: We design products around how African businesses and individuals actually live, work, and make decisions.

siteCopy.aboutHeroTitle: We turn useful ideas into focused digital products.
siteCopy.aboutHeroIntro: Synteone comes from synthesis and one. We bring many ideas into one company, then give each product the focus it needs to become useful and trusted.
siteCopy.aboutRegisteredText: We are registered in Rwanda and building for African markets.
siteCopy.productsHeroTitle: We build products when the problem is clear.
siteCopy.productsHeroIntro: We create innovative digital products for businesses and individuals, then give each product our full focus until it is proven.
siteCopy.homeWhatTitle: We build digital products across the markets people use every day.
siteCopy.homeWhatBody: We build innovative digital products for businesses and individuals, spanning technology, financial services, hospitality and tourism, real estate, and retail and commerce.
siteCopy.homeWhyTitle: We build close to the market we serve.
siteCopy.homeWhyBodyOne: Our customers need digital products that respect local operating realities, customer behavior, payment habits, and trust gaps.
siteCopy.homeWhyBodyTwo: We compete on trust and genuine relevance, not on being the cheapest option.
siteCopy.homeVision: To become a leading African technology company, creating trusted digital products that improve how people live, work, and do business across Africa and beyond.
siteCopy.homeMission: Synteone builds innovative digital products that solve real problems for businesses and individuals, starting in Africa.
